design_persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer - Swiss Editorial & Precision Agriculture
theme: Light theme default with deep forest dark accents (#0F291E)

design_principles_and_news_page_alignmen.sharp_edges_mandate: All course cards, thumbnails, preview containers, and CTAs MUST have borderRadius: 0 matching NewsUI.tsx editorial design language.
design_principles_and_news_page_alignmen.cta_button_styling: Primary actions use rectangular sharp-edged buttons with side arrow boxes, bold uppercase typography, and zero rounded corners.
design_principles_and_news_page_alignmen.content_reprioritization: Buried coming-soon marketing is removed from top. Actual learning tracks from MongoDB/API appear immediately at the top with level filters.
design_principles_and_news_page_alignmen.no_fake_elements: STRICT PROHIBITION of fake video players, fake reviews, learner counts, certification badges, or invented launch dates. Lesson previews are 100% text-based.

academy_page.description: Compact page title with editorial pill selector (ALL, BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED) allowing fast discovery.
Sharp-edged hero course card using NewsUI FeaturedStory layout: top aspect-ratio image, IN FOCUS badge, level tag, title, outcome excerpt, and Read/Preview CTA.
Sharp-edged horizontal story card stack matching NewsStoryCard layout with course thumbnail on right, level tag, title, duration, and Preview CTA.
Forest-green dark block showcasing key text takeaways of the selected preview lesson, featuring clear bullet points and readable typography.
Clean, sharp-edged rectangular waitlist box with crisp field inputs and green rectangular submit CTA.
Sharp divider links to Shop, Specialist Services, and Tools.

course_detail_page.description: Sharp image header with dark gradient overlay, track pill, level badge, title, and duration.
Sharp white card with check icon list of verified outcomes.
Expanded forest card featuring the full text summary and actionable key points for the preview lesson (no fake video controls).
Accordion module list clearly marking free preview lessons vs locked future lessons.
Sharp-edged rectangular button to register for full course launch.

CourseCard.style: borderRadius: 0, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: #E2E8F0, backgroundColor: #FFFFFF, paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 16
CourseCard.cta_button: ReadArticleButton equivalent for course preview: rectangular, sharp, with arrow icon.

TextLessonPreview.badge: TEXT PREVIEW • 6 MIN READ (no play icon)
TextLessonPreview.bullet_points: Jakarta-500 text with lime bullet indicators

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: All pressable cards, buttons, module triggers, and filter chips MUST retain explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='academy-filter-beginner', data-testid='academy-course-foundations').
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large headers against forest dark and white surfaces.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.smooth_transitions: Use specific property transitions (e.g., opacity, transform) avoiding universal transition: all.
